title: Shinonome Ena — Profile Story

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Our self-intros as members of N25...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I thought we were taking a break. Can't we do something a little easier? I mean, I introduced myself to my new class the other day, which was a pain...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Huh...?
How did I introduce myself for night school?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Well...
I said my name and how I'm looking forward to this upcoming year... That was about it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<H-Hey, cut me some slack!
Everyone else said pretty much the same thing!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay, fine, geez...
Just a quick introduction.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um... I'm Ena Shinonome, also known as Enanan. I draw illustrations for Nightcord at 25:00.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I've been drawing since I was little, but I almost lost that ability after life decided to throw a few curveballs at me...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That was when I discovered Kanade's... K's music. I felt inspired to draw again, and I really liked what I was able to produce.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <After that, our video editor, Amia, and K herself reached out to me, and asked me to join N25.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now that I think about it, a lot's happened.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I entered into that contest and didn't win a thing, I started going back to that art class... It's been a pretty wild year for me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But above all else, I'm taking a much harder look at my art compared to before...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I think N25 made that possible for me.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Moving forward, I want to keep drawing the best illustrations I can for K and Yuki's music. Our music...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, we'll be looking forward to your continued support.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<How's that..?
Huh? Now what?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Boring? Too buttoned-up?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Look here... Is that all you have to say after making me do it?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Alright, fine.
That means you're gonna knock our socks off with your self-intro, right?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What?! That has nothing to do with this...?!
I'm not drawing that new section for you if you try to duck out!>
